- [warning] packages/lntt/test/review-cli.test.ts:394 — the "ignores SIGTERM is killed" test would still pass if the 5-second SIGKILL timer in `terminate` (`review-cli.ts:215`) were removed, because the `process.on('exit')` handler at `review-cli.ts:233` also SIGKILLs every group; it also races with pid reuse — make the agent record when it dies, or have a required agent hold the round open past 5s so only the timer can kill it; `not checked: needs a mutation run on review-cli.ts:219`
- [warning] packages/lntt/test/review-cli.test.ts:426 — the title promises a beat every 15 seconds, but nothing asserts a `beat` event, and the `beats % 2` stderr throttle at `review-cli.ts:169` has no test; only the pid is checked — assert a beat (for example inject the interval) or drop the claim from the title.
- [warning] packages/lntt/src/review.ts:224 — `verifiersFor` is documented as "at least one required verifier always checks it", but the test covers only two cases: one required and one optional agent in the pool. A pool of only optional agents, a finder that is optional, and a finder absent from the pool all go unchecked, and the all-optional pool returns `others` with no required verifier — add those cases.
- [warning] packages/lntt/test/review-cli.test.ts:372 — the host-hook test checks only `ORCA_AGENT_HOOK_PORT` in the agent's environment; `ORCA_PANE_KEY`, `ORCA_TAB_ID`, `ORCA_AGENT_LAUNCH_TOKEN` and `HERDR_*` in `HOST_HOOKS` (`review-cli.ts:243`), and that `inv.env` still overrides, are untested — add a unit test of the exported `agentEnv`.
- [warning] packages/lntt/src/review-cli.ts:498 — the `main` catch path that starts the progress file when the error comes before `round` runs `startProgress` (a bad argument, say) is never reached; the "cannot start" test fails only after `startProgress`. Neither `--plan` (`review-cli.ts:331`) nor `reply` writing no progress file is tested either — add those cases.
- [warning] packages/lntt/test/orca-subagents.test.ts:49 — the re-announce test depends on real 10ms timers and sleeps of 25–35ms, and `>= 3` starts will flake on a loaded CI machine; use fake timers (`mock.timers`) or poll until a condition holds. It also never checks that `close()` stops a1 only once or that `stop` sends the message.
- [note] packages/lntt/src/review-cli.ts:114 — `formatTokens` is tested only through two end-to-end values (1.5k, 3k); the `<1000` branch, the million branch and the `.0k`/`.0M` replacement have no test — add a unit test, including 999, 1000, 1_000_000 and 10_000.
- [note] packages/lntt/test/headless.test.ts:78 — token parsing has no case for `usage` with non-numeric fields, a Claude reply with `usage` absent alongside a cost, or opencode `step_finish` events without `tokens` (null), nor does `addTokens` have a test with mixed null and numeric replies; add the malformed-input cases.
- [note] packages/lntt/test/review.test.ts:833 — `findingLines` appends any unbulleted line that follows a finding to it, as in the 'Some closing words.' case. The test checks only the count of 0 and never the text that results, so an action polluted by closing prose is not caught — assert the parsed `action` there, and add a blank-line terminator case.
- [note] packages/lntt/test/headless.test.ts:340 — the round-signal test does not cover the combination of an optional agent with `options.signal` (`AbortSignal.any` at `headless.ts:198`) or a signal already aborted before the first slot; add a case for each.
- [note] packages/lntt/test/review-cli.test.ts:324 — the caffeinate test is skipped off macOS, so the `process.platform` guard in `keepAwake` (`review-cli.ts:306`) and the missing-`caffeinate` path are not tested on any platform; add a unit test of the guard or accept the gap.
